ns2:course.label: Principles and Practices to Foster Independence in Reading
ns2:course.description: Emphasizes reading comprehension and reading to learn in content fields in grades K-8. Includes focus on teaching reading to students from diverse cultural and linguistic backgrounds, including dialect speakers and English learners. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours.
ns2:course.sectionCappArea: Restricted to Admitted Teacher Ed Student students.
